messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — QuantumFlux (analytics) just onboarded 3 new squads and their traffic doubled this week. They reported ~800k tokens/hr last week -> ~1.7M tokens/hr now. They're asking for guidance on cost predictability and a capacity plan ahead of renewal next month.

jordan_se: Received. Do we know the request mix? embeddings vs generation vs rerank?

maya_cs: Customer said ~60% embeddings, 25% generation (short responses), 15% reranking. They also want a nightly batch embed job that hits ~200k items.

sam_sre: OK. Rough numbers matter for autoscale config. Can we get expected peak RPS and token burst size? p95 latency target?

maya_cs: They're targeting p95 <= 300ms for generation and embeddings. Peak burst they said can hit ~220 concurrent requests with 2-3k tokens each in the worst case during analytics runs.

jordan_se: If their p95 goal holds we'll want to recommend a dedicated pool (reserved capacity) with 2x baseline headroom + burst policy. Also suggest prefix caching for the nightly job to reduce KV misses.

li_product: We should offer a short enablement: 30–45m session for their infra folks on batching/caching and quantization recommendations. I'll draft a slide deck + playbook.

maya_cs: Customer asked for a cost forecast for three scenarios (baseline, +50% load, +200% burst). I can produce a back-of-envelope but would like engineering numbers for per-token cost with current config vs q4 quantized profile.

sam_sre: I'll run a quick sim today. Can you share the sample request distribution? A CSV or snippet helps.

maya_cs: Pasting sanitized distribution snippet: 
```
scenario,embeddings_pct,generation_pct,rerank_pct,avg_tokens_per_req
baseline,0.6,0.25,0.15,350
+50pct,0.6,0.25,0.15,380
burst,0.6,0.25,0.15,1200
```

jordan_se: Perfect. I'll estimate token/sec and recommend pool size. Also flag: if they want private/VPC (they asked), that adds setup time and a one-time infra fee — mention in the forecast.

maya_cs: FYI they said they're evaluating another provider for predictable pricing, so this is a renewal risk if we don't get them a clear plan.

li_product: Let's offer a limited trial of a dedicated pool for 2 weeks at a discounted rate to let them validate perf and cost. If they sign, we can roll to reserved capacity. Thoughts?

sam_sre: Works for me, but ops needs an onboarding window. ops-bot: deploy scheduled: capacity-sim v2 -> staging at 2024-11-15T09:30:00Z :rocket:

maya_cs: I'll propose the trial + enablement in my check-in tomorrow. Jordan/Sam/Li — can you send estimated numbers and slide notes by EOD so I have a pack for the customer call?

jordan_se: On it.

sam_sre: Will share sims by 18:00 PT.

li_product: Drafting the enablement deck now, will push comments to the slide doc. :thumbsup:

maya_cs: Thanks team. I'll update thread after tomorrow's customer call.
